definitions.explanation: A formal talk given to an audience.
A public speech, especially on a formal occasion.

examples.japanese: {演説|えんぜつ}を{行|おこな}う。
{選挙|せんきょ}{演説|えんぜつ}を{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I listened to an election speech.

examples.japanese: {街頭|がいとう}{演説|えんぜつ}をする。

notes:
{演説|えんぜつ} refers to formal speeches.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {演説|えんぜつ}する (to give a speech)
- {演説|えんぜつ}を{行|おこな}う (to deliver a speech)
- {演説|えんぜつ}を{聞|き}く (to listen to a speech)

COMMON TYPES:
- {選挙|せんきょ}{演説|えんぜつ}: election speech
- {街頭|がいとう}{演説|えんぜつ}: street speech
- {就任|しゅうにん}{演説|えんぜつ}: inaugural address

SIMILAR:
- スピーチ: speech (loanword, less formal)
